title: Classiq and Ventum Consulting Partner on Enterprise Quantum Computing in Germany
excerpt: Classiq and Ventum Consulting have partnered to help German enterprises develop quantum computing strategies & assess potential applications.
content:
Insider Brief

  • Classiq and Ventum Consulting have partnered to help German enterprises develop quantum computing strategies, build internal expertise and identify potential applications.
  • The collaboration combines Classiq‘s quantum software platform and application development capabilities with Ventum Consulting’s experience in business strategy and organisational transformation.
  • The companies will work with enterprise teams to assess use cases, prioritise applications and develop quantum software that can be tested on quantum hardware and simulators.

PRESS RELEASE — Classiq, a leading quantum computing software company, and Ventum Consulting, a digital transformation consultancy, today announced a partnership to help enterprises in Germany build quantum computing expertise, establish strategies and develop applications aligned with their business priorities.

The partnership brings together Classiq’s quantum software platform and application development expertise with Ventum Consulting’s experience in business strategy, technology and organizational transformation. Together, the companies will help enterprises assess the relevance of quantum computing to their operations and establish a practical path from initial exploration to application development.

Preparing for quantum computing requires time to identify suitable problems, build internal expertise and develop software. The collaboration will enable organizations to begin that preparation today, connecting their business priorities with the technical knowledge and development capabilities needed to evaluate quantum approaches as the technology advances.

Classiq and Ventum Consulting will work jointly with business and technical teams to build understanding, identify and prioritize potential use cases, and shape quantum computing strategies. This work will provide a foundation for developing and testing applications, with objectives informed by each organization’s needs, resources and stage of preparation.

“Enterprises can start building the knowledge and software they will need to take advantage of advances in quantum computing,” said Nir Minerbi, CEO and co-founder of Classiq. “Our partnership with Ventum Consulting brings together the business understanding, quantum expertise and development platform to support that process. We want to help companies in Germany translate their priorities into applications and build experience that will serve them as quantum capabilities grow.”

“For enterprise leaders, preparing for quantum computing begins with understanding where the relevant business problem and potentials lie and what it will take to make the organization ready to leverage the exciting technology,” said Tim Naumann Head of Business and IT Transformation at Ventum Consulting. “Working with Classiq, we can help clients connect those questions to a clear strategy and practical development work. Our shared focus is on building expertise within their organizations and giving them a sound basis for decisions about quantum computing – basically we want to help shortcutting the upcoming hypercycle.”

The Classiq platform provides the software foundation for this work, enabling teams to develop quantum algorithms at a high level, automate the creation of optimized quantum circuits, and test applications across quantum hardware and simulators. This approach supports the development of software that can be refined and adapted as hardware capabilities evolve.

Through the partnership, Classiq and Ventum Consulting aim to make quantum application development more accessible to German enterprises and support the knowledge, skills and strategic preparation needed for sustained progress.
